message.reasoning_content:
I will write the scene as a single JSON plan object matching the exact schema.

The scene is ST1 with intimacy inactive. The player will visibly grip the blade tighter to reclaim power. A-plot progress must be concrete and visible: the PC discovers the wish succeeded in an impossible way. The previous ending left witnesses hesitating over The Answer, so this scene must advance that situation.

The scene will take place in the ritual clearing. The cast includes Lirael, Julian, Seren, unnamed witnesses, and a presiding Dohkar. It will use first-person present tense narration with three to four phases. VisualState fields must be populated.

The scene will stage The Answer pulsing once and naming the found sister aloud. This makes the wish's impossible success concrete and visible. The PC must choose between accepting that impossible result or rejecting its source. Julian needs at least one meaningful moment. The length should stay under 1000 words with no microDecision.

The visualState will use a crimson spiralgrass clearing at dusk, with the camera over the PC's shoulder and the PC shown in side profile or back view. Only Seren is named among the other characters present; the presiding Dohkar remains an unnamed authority figure.

The scene will be structured in four beats. The first shows the PC tightening the blade. The second shows The Answer pulsing and naming the lost sister. The third shows Julian's reaction. The fourth leaves the PC facing the choice between accepting the impossible success or rejecting its source.
